comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Left is 1 if any comment directly argues against or challenges the OP's view (a substantive rebuttal). Right is 1 if any comment explicitly quotes OP title or argument text verbatim or near-verbatim, and endorsement or refutation is not required. A comment can rebut without quoting, and a comment can quote without rebutting. The null and empty-list rules also differ.
